title: GroupPermissionCatalog
description: Closed, code-owned catalog of GROUP-SCOPED permissions. Same discipline as the network catalog (permission/permission.catalog.json): each key names a real enforcement point, roles bundle the keys as DATA, and a new key ships with its gate. Separate from the network catalog because these keys are only ever evaluated relative to one group, never globally. `requiresNetworkPermission` is the hard cap: where a capability also exists network-wide, BOTH must hold, so a group can never become a way around network policy. A `<type>` placeholder in it is resolved against the group's visibility (see ../groupPermission/prerequisites.ts). The `groupsEnabled` policy gates every key and is therefore applied in code rather than repeated in each entry.

group.read.description: See the group's profile beyond the always-public fields.

group.content.read.description: Read the group's posts and comments.

group.members.read.description: See the group's member list and its member count.

group.comment.create.description: Comment on posts in the group.

group.post.pin.description: Pin and unpin posts within the group.

group.post.moderate.description: Remove someone else's post from this group. The post itself stays with its author — what is taken away is its place in the group.

group.join.description: Join the group directly, without approval.

group.join.request.description: Ask to join the group, becoming a pending applicant.

group.member.remove.description: Remove a member from the group, subject to the act-on hierarchy.

group.member.role.assign.description: Change a member's role in the group, subject to the act-on hierarchy and to holding every right the assigned role holds.

group.invite.description: Generate group invite codes for people who already have an account on this network.

group.invite.external.description: Generate group invite codes that also entitle their holder to register an account.

group.settings.manage.description: Change the group's settings: name, about, description, avatar, location, categories and member-list visibility.

group.role.manage.description: Edit this group's own role definitions.

group.chat.read.description: Read the group's chat room: have it in one's chat list, read its messages and be notified of new ones. A membership right — the non-member role cannot hold it.

group.chat.write.description: Write in the group's chat room — text, files and voice messages. Implies reading it.

group.videoCall.create.description: Open a video call in the group. Capped network-side by whether the group is one a stranger can walk into (videoCall.create_open) or not (videoCall.create_restricted).

group.videoCall.join.description: Join a video call already running in the group.
